description: Patch Release: Fix plaintext password inputs, enable malware scan, fix session secure cookie behind proxies, remove debug logs, fix TinyMCE image URL/paste, fix RSS self-link for subfolders.
changes: Fix password input fields from type=text to type=password (create-post.php, edit-post.php)
Enable upload malware scan by default (config.php)
Fix session cookie secure flag to respect TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS (Security.php)
Remove debug console.log statements from production (create-post.php, edit-post.php)
Fix TinyMCE image URL insertion stripping class/style attributes (create-post.php, edit-post.php)
Enable paste_data_images in TinyMCE for image paste support (create-post.php, edit-post.php)
Fix RSS self-link for subfolder installs using cms_path() (rss.php)
